name: Escape the Archive
description: A U.S. History digital escape room. Students are locked in an archive and open four padlocks (a year dial, a word lock, an insignia lock and a timeline lock) using clues from primary sources: the Gettysburg Address, the Preamble, the Little Rock Nine crisis of 1957 and the 19th Amendment. Auto-graded at 25 points per lock, with optional hints that cost 5 points and an optional time limit. Progress is saved; SpeedGrader shows every lock, wrong try, hint and time.
author: Virtual Arkansas

parameters.label: Allow hints (each hint used costs 5 points)
